tasks.label: cmake build (scarab)
tasks.detail: Builds scarab and copies it's runtime resources (games/caravellius Lua scripts/configs/sprites/audio) into build/ - wired as every debug launch config's preLaunchTask, so Run/Debug can never launch against stale copied resources the way a plain 'run the existing binary' launch could.

tasks.label: cmake build (caravellius_archive)
tasks.detail: Builds scarab (via 'cmake build (scarab)' first) AND packages Caravellius's resources into build/games/caravellius/caravellius.zip (Phase 12, archive-distribution) - caravellius_archive isn't part of the default ALL build, so it needs this dedicated task. Wired as every '... Launch Archive' debug config's own preLaunchTask, so those always debug against a freshly rebuilt archive, never a stale one.
